author: Alphareview
quote: This GTA game is unlike any other GTA game, no fun at all. You can’t steal cars quickly, doesn’t have hookers, have to workout and eat, have to use petrol inbetween driving, cannot steal cars in neighbourhood, doesn’t give freedom to change partner, doesn’t give cheats to lower wanted levels, etc. So basically it’s GTA Sims and not GTA that we were expecting.
